name: milestone_three_methodology_audit
objective: Identify methodological flaws that could still make Milestone Three falsely conclude that DREAM adds value or that claim extraction generalizes. Address reviewer bias, unblinding leakage, token-budget confounding, task selection, and inter-rater disagreement. Give one concrete IDEA and its ASSUMPTION. Use at most 120 words.
hypothesis: Adversarial audit will expose remaining confounding between prompt length and divergence, evaluator leakage, and subtle unblinding cues.

evidence.text: Milestone Three enforces equal candidate counts, independent natural prose, and blinded multi-rater packets.

perturbations.text: Blinded evaluation guarantees zero bias even if prompt verbosity or candidate style reveals the generative condition.
Equal candidate count ensures fair comparison even if DREAM produces substantially longer responses.
